scope: PROMPTS.md items 2-20, 9 action sheets + 10 VFX sheets
coordinate_convention: zero-based cell-local x,y; bbox=[x,y,width,height]; alpha bbox never used to recenter character frames

geometry_policy.character_anchors: Original darius_cells.json pivots retained. Head anchors rounded to cells; idle forced 1-cell bob, run head x fixed to 50. Limbs and shaft endpoints are recorded pose approximations, not recovered 3D bones.
geometry_policy.ground_line_conflict: Prose says y=78; actual provided idle render/design/head coordinates place standing boots at y=72 inclusive. Keep reference position; do not shift every frame to prose line.

processing.method: native-grid reconstruction with approved-design parts and reference pose landmarks; exact head stencil pasted last
